lines.text: Many learners say: She said me to wait.
Better: She told me to wait.
Use told with me, not said.
Told! She told me to wait.

data.why: Use told with me, not said.

native.hook: 「said me」？ それとも told me？
native.tip: 「私に言う」は tell me。say の直後に me は置けません（say to me ならOK）。
native.caption: “She said me to wait.”と言っていませんか？😅 「言う」を say だけで訳すと said me になりがちです。“She told me to wait.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“told”。“She told me to wait.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Say told me, not said me.
en.caption: Do you say this? “She said me to wait.” 😅 Japanese speakers often use say for every kind of “say.” The natural way is “She told me to wait.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
